name: Boom Bap Kit
author: Versilian Studios & Karoryfer Samples (recordings) / processed for DAW
desc: Dusty 90s boom-bap kit: SP-1200-style crunchy kick, cracking snare, crisp short hats (real drums, 12-bit). 85-95 BPM, swing 0.1-0.25: kick on 1 & the "and" of 2/3, snare 2 & 4, 8th/16th hats with velocity accents. Notes: 36 kick, 38 snare, 42 hat, 46 open, 39 clap, 37 rim.
attribution: Virtuosity Drums by Versilian Studios & Karoryfer Samples (drummer Austin McMahon, recorded at Virtuosity Musical Instruments, Boston). CC0 1.0; Claps from VCSL (Versilian Community Sample Library) by Versilian Studios. CC0 1.0. Processed (12-bit/26 kHz, saturation) by tools/build-hiphop.py.
